explanation: Mark Twain was the pen name of Samuel Clemens. It comes from a riverboat call meaning two fathoms deep, about 3.7 m (12 feet), safe water for a steamboat.

claims.text: Mark Twain wrote The Adventures of Tom Sawyer.
Herman Melville, Jack London and Washington Irving did not write The Adventures of Tom Sawyer.
Mark Twain was the pen name of Samuel Clemens.
The pen name comes from the riverboat call 'mark twain', meaning a depth of two fathoms, safe water for a steamboat.
Two fathoms is 12 feet, about 3.7 m.
